description: Instantly pick a provably-fair random winner (or winners) from a list of entrants. The randomness comes from the public drand beacon, so the result is verifiable and cannot be rigged. Use for giveaways, raffles, fair selection, tie-breaks, or any 'pick one at random, provably' need.

entrants.description: List of entrants (names, @handles, wallet addresses, anything).

name: pick_winner_now
